verdict.rationale: Retell's first-party docs state that a single- or multi-prompt agent can connect to a remote MCP server and call that server's tools during a live voice or chat conversation. That is exactly the story of one integration granting a whole toolset mid-call. Retell's own MCP server (for building agents from Cursor or Claude) is a separate server-side role and is not credited here. Missing for 10: detail on configuration (auth, tool filtering, multiple servers, conversation-flow agent support) and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my voice agent can plug in MCP servers as tool sources so one integration grants it whole toolsets mid-call

citations.quote: Connect your single- or multi-prompt agent to a remote Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, and the agent can call that server's tools during a live call.
Connect a Retell single- or multi-prompt agent to a remote MCP server so it can call the server's tools during a live voice or chat conversation.
